title: RendererHints
description: Optional metadata attached to any item (Backpack, Doctrine, or Hoard) that tells renderers how the item is allowed to surface. Renderers MAY ignore hints, but SHOULD respect 'never_surface_in' and 'requires_consent'.

surfaces.description: Renderers this item is appropriate for.

never_surface_in.description: Renderers that MUST NOT include this item.

priority.description: Higher = more likely to be surfaced when budget is tight.

tone_constraints.description: Tones this item should NOT be reframed into.

preferred_narrators.description: Narrator role/skin ids this item reads well in.

requires_consent.description: If true, renderers must check an explicit user-consent flag before surfacing (e.g. health, mood, sensitive history).

decay.description: Whether the item should fade in priority or drop from rendering as it ages, independent of TTL.

ambient_only.description: If true, only ambient renderers (statusline, HUD) should surface it; never push as an alert.

SurfaceId.description: Renderer/surface identifier. Reserved canonical ids; custom ids allowed.
